a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreement (two rounds of operating before anyone takes) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks the agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the random split will probably leave us both short. After I take, I'll operate every round so you can build the reserve back up. If you'd rather propose a different plan, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
